selection: Select 150 House roll calls by documented issue, nonprocedural impact, topic, vote date and bill identifier before joining any survey results. Provide inclusion/exclusion logs and independent review. First 150 numbered roll calls are NOT automatically 150 key votes.
requiredPreferences: District-by-issue pre-vote estimates for bottom/middle/top income terciles
Verified districts and issue question wording
Survey weights and subgroup effective sample sizes >=30 for each income tercile
comment: Official votes may be collected before matched preference data. No observed income-responsiveness coefficients can be published from the vote index alone.
